title: A finite module over a Noetherian ring has a resolution by finite free modules (Stacks 00LP)
statement: Let $R$ be a Noetherian ring [def-weil-pbc-noetherian-ring] and $M$ a finitely generated $R$-module [def-weil-finitely-generated-module]. Then there exist integers $n_0,n_1,n_2,\ldots\ge0$ and $R$-linear maps forming an exact complex $$\cdots\to R^{\oplus n_2}\xrightarrow{d_2}R^{\oplus n_1}\xrightarrow{d_1}R^{\oplus n_0}\xrightarrow{\varepsilon}M\to0,$$ i.e. $\varepsilon$ is surjective, $\ker\varepsilon=\operatorname{im}d_1$ and $\ker d_i=\operatorname{im}d_{i+1}$ for all $i\ge1$; in particular it is a resolution of $M$ by finite free $R$-modules.
